title: juniperus deppeana
intro: Juniperus deppeana, commonly known as Mexican Juniper or Pinon, is a species of evergreen tree in the cypress family (Cupressaceae) native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of Juniperus deppeana include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which make it useful for treating urinary tract infections, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Juniperus deppeana include pinene, limonene, and borneol, which contribute to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
